$comment: Configuration overlay for the end-to-end update drill (run-e2e.mjs). It gives the test build its own identity and its own program name (snappy-e2e.exe), so it can never touch or be mistaken for a real Snappy install, its data or its process. The drill adds a `version` for each build. Never used for a release: build.rs refuses the test feature without this identifier, and refuses it outright when SNAPPY_RELEASE=1.
